title: Austin's New Administration Takes Office
summary:
*   A special meeting was called to finalize any pending city matters.
*   The primary agenda item was the formal inauguration and organization of the city's new leadership for the 1967-1969 term.
*   This session marked the official swearing-in and setup for the incoming city administration, kicking off its two-year period.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 15th day of
May, 1967, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 10:00 A.M.
for the purpose of completion of unfinished business and Inauguration and Organization of
the 1967-1969 Council.
S/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
ATTEST:
S/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
S/ Lester E. Palmer
Mayor
CONSENT TO MEETING
We, the undersigned members of the City Council, hereby accept service of the foregoing
notice, waiving any and all irregularities in such service and such notice, and consent
and agree that said City Council shall meet at the time and place therein named, and for
the purpose therein stated. S/ Travis LaRue
S/ Emma. Long
S/ Dick Nichols
